# Synthetic test screens

`syn*.png` and `gt.json` come from `gen.py` (seed 7): 12 screens of 1080×2400, 168
Vietnamese / English UI lines, light and dark, 40–72 px. `gt.json` maps each screen
to its lines (`text`, `box`).

The images show text rendered with these fonts (the fonts themselves are not in the repo):

- Roboto Regular / Medium — Apache License 2.0
- Noto Sans — SIL Open Font License 1.1
- DejaVu Sans — Bitstream Vera / DejaVu free licence
